description: Platform-agnostic variable dictionary. Variables are organized by scope group. The agent MUST prefer these names over inventing new ones. Domain-specific variables (e.g. resort_code) are kept but tagged domain:funnel|catalog so the agent knows they don't apply universally.

groups.context: Variables present on every page_view event across all pages
groups.user: User properties sent with every page_view (GA4 user scope)
groups.product: Variables tied to a specific product / item on the page
groups.funnel: Variables specific to a multi-step conversion funnel
groups.search: Variables tied to search and filter interactions
groups.interaction: Variables carried by click_* events (event_click payload)

variables.name: page_name
variables.description: Unique page identifier. Pattern: {site_section}_{page_id}. E.g. shopping_homepage, be_accommodation, error_not_found.

variables.name: site_section
variables.description: Top-level application section.

variables.name: referrer
variables.description: Previous page URL or page_name.

variables.name: connection_status
variables.description: Authentication state of the current visitor.

variables.name: locale
variables.description: Browser/app locale, e.g. fr-FR.

variables.name: currency
variables.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR.

variables.name: country_code
variables.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code derived from browser/IP.

variables.name: country_name
variables.description: Human-readable country name.

variables.name: country_language
variables.description: Language of the country, e.g. french.

variables.name: environment
variables.description: Deployment environment.

variables.name: neolane_id
variables.description: CRM / campaign system user ID. False when not set.

variables.name: visitor_guid
variables.description: Persistent anonymous visitor GUID.

variables.name: full_visitor_id
variables.description: GA client ID (full_visitor_id).

variables.name: lead_scoring_range
variables.description: Engagement/intent score bracket, e.g. hot, warm, cold.

variables.name: fidelity_status
variables.description: Loyalty programme tier, e.g. platinum, gold, member, none.

variables.name: be_customer_status
variables.description: CRM customer lifecycle stage.

variables.name: business_unit
variables.description: Geo/brand business unit, e.g. EAF, Americas.

variables.name: email_sha_256
variables.description: SHA-256 hash of the authenticated user's email. Null/absent when not logged in.

variables.name: detail_click
variables.description: Stable, language-independent slug identifying the precise action inside the click zone. Snake_case. E.g. validate_step, criterias_when, media_photos.

variables.name: content_position
variables.description: 1-based position of a content item in a list or carousel.

variables.name: banner_name
variables.description: Label or identifier of a displayed banner or promotional block.

variables.name: url_redirect
variables.description: Destination URL of a clickable content item or offer card.

variables.name: error_code
variables.description: Application error code shown to the user.

variables.name: item_id
variables.description: Unique product/item identifier (GA4 items[].item_id). Also used as resort_code or product code.

variables.name: item_name
variables.description: Product display name (GA4 items[].item_name).

variables.name: item_category
variables.description: Primary product category (GA4 items[].item_category). E.g. room type, product type.

variables.name: item_category2
variables.description: Secondary category dimension (GA4 items[].item_category2). Usage varies by domain.

variables.name: item_category3
variables.description: Tertiary category dimension.

variables.name: item_category4
variables.description: Quaternary category dimension.

variables.name: item_category5
variables.description: Quinary category dimension.

variables.name: price
variables.description: Unit price of the product (GA4 items[].price).

variables.name: coupon
variables.description: Promotion/coupon code applied to this item. 'no' when absent.

variables.name: discount
variables.description: Monetary discount applied to this item.

variables.name: index
variables.description: 0-based position of the item in a list result set (GA4 items[].index).

variables.name: search_terms
variables.description: Raw search query entered by the user.

variables.name: search_request_type
variables.description: How the search was submitted, e.g. autocomplete, free_text, voice.

variables.name: search_filters
variables.description: Active filter IDs as a delimited string. 'no_filters' when none.

variables.name: search_results_number
variables.description: Number of results returned by the search.

variables.name: product_id
variables.description: Product identifier returned in a search result (item in list).

variables.name: destination_country
variables.description: Country filter applied in search.

variables.name: destination_region
variables.description: Region filter applied in search.

variables.name: reference_id
variables.description: Unique identifier for the current cart, booking proposal, or order.

variables.name: reference_type
variables.description: Nature of the reference / dossier.

variables.name: reference_source
variables.description: Channel that originated the reference.

variables.name: transaction_id
variables.description: Confirmed booking / order ID (GA4 purchase.transaction_id).

variables.name: comparator
variables.description: 'yes' if user arrived via a comparison tool/page, 'no' otherwise.

variables.name: rate_type
variables.description: Pricing flexibility tier, e.g. non_refundable_rate, standard, flexible_rate.

variables.name: payment_plan
variables.description: Payment schedule chosen.

variables.name: payment_method
variables.description: Payment instrument, e.g. credit_card, bank_transfer, paypal.

variables.name: payment_status
variables.description: Outcome of the payment attempt.

variables.name: option_ID
variables.description: Identifier of a held option (pre-booking reservation).

variables.name: insurance_subscribed
variables.description: 'yes' / 'no' — whether the user subscribed to cancellation insurance.

variables.name: upsell_name
variables.description: Identifier of an upsell add-on.

variables.name: upsell_category
variables.description: Category of the upsell, e.g. transfer, insurance, activity, room.

variables.name: upsell_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of the upsell added.

variables.name: upsell_revenue
variables.description: Revenue value of a single upsell.

variables.name: upsell_revenue_total
variables.description: Total upsell revenue for the transaction.

variables.name: donation
variables.description: Donation amount selected ('no' or numeric value as string).

variables.name: base_price_%step_name
variables.description: Price shown at the current funnel step. Key changes per step, e.g. base_price_accommodation.

variables.name: stats_cookie
variables.description: Analytics cookie consent flag (0 or 1).

variables.name: media_cookie
variables.description: Media/advertising cookie consent flag (0 or 1).

variables.name: perso_cookie
variables.description: Personalisation cookie consent flag (0 or 1).
